about_short_description.short_description: Payroll and recruitment platform helping the construction industry hire and retain talented site teams.

product.name: Sales Outreach Campaigns
product.description: Managed sales outreach campaigns targeting potential clients to generate qualified leads for recruitment agencies.

product.name: Candidate Resourcing Support
product.description: Provides unlimited candidate sourcing and shortlisting support to recruitment agencies to fill vacancies efficiently.

product.name: Candidate Re-marketing Campaigns
product.description: Runs targeted campaigns to re-market previously submitted candidates to new potential employers to maximize placement opportunities.

product.name: Market Mapping and Expansion Support
product.description: Builds and maintains candidate and client databases to help recruitment agencies enter and test new markets quickly.

product.name: Headhunting Services
product.description: Engages passive candidates continuously to provide recruitment agencies with introductions to suitable candidates when vacancies arise.
